### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

`ChatCompletionRequest` accepts message `content` as either a string or a list of content parts. However, `generate_chat_conv` rejects `system` and `assistant` messages containing more than one text part.

For example, `"You are helpful."` works, but the same text split into `"You are "` and `"helpful."` returns HTTP 400. Multi-part `user` messages already work because their text parts are concatenated.

I reproduced this on every release from 0.4.5.post1 through 0.5.18, as well as on current `main` (`f8cbf000`). The bug is found by a fuzzer and the issue is co-authored with LLM.

### Reproduction

Start a 0.5.18 server:

```bash
pip install "sglang[all]==0.5.18"
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B \
    --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30218 --context-length 4096 \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.45 --disable-cuda-graph --chat-template chatml
```

```bash
# Fails: the system message contains two text parts.
curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:30218/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"m","max_tokens":8,"messages":[
        {"role":"system","content":[{"type":"text","text":"You are "},
                                    {"type":"text","text":"helpful."}]},
        {"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
# {"object":"error","message":"The system message should be a single text.",
#  "type":"BadRequest","param":null,"code":400}
# HTTP 400

# Works: the same text is passed as a string.
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:30218/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"m","max_tokens":8,"messages":[
        {"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},
        {"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
# HTTP 200
```

The bug can also be reproduced without a server, GPU, or model weights:

```python
# pip install "sglang[all]==0.5.18" — CPU only
from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest
from sglang.srt.parser.conversation import generate_chat_conv

def conv(system_content):
    req = ChatCompletionRequest(model="m", messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": system_content},
        {"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
    generate_chat_conv(req, "chatml")

conv("You are helpful.")                                # renders
conv([{"type": "text", "text": "You are helpful."}])    # renders
conv([{"type": "text", "text": "You are "},
      {"type": "text", "text": "helpful."}])
# ValueError: The system message should be a single text.
```

### Expected behavior

Text parts in `system` and `assistant` messages should be concatenated, as they already are for `user` messages. Non-text parts can still be rejected.

The relevant code is in `python/sglang/srt/parser/conversation.py` (around lines 640 and 703).

comments.body: I'd like to fix this by concatenating text parts for system/assistant messages, consistent with how user messages are currently handled. I have reviewed the timeline and did not see an open pull request for this. Please let me know if this work is already in progress.

title: [Bug] Multi-part text content is rejected for system and assistant messages
